plan.title: Mandatory T&C acceptance on eRFX Auction

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publication.
Provide the mandatory event title using a unique generated title.
Apply an Auction pricing template.
Add the auction line item required for bidding.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the line item.

args.goal: On the Auction create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" so both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen.

steps.note: Configure and verify the two mandatory event terms, which have no dedicated domain step.
Add the available QA test vendor to the Auction.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Publish the event after all creation requirements are complete.
Verify that publication reached a real event page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's Auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Have the vendor accept the first mandatory clause.
Have the vendor accept the second mandatory clause.
Quote 100 for every line and submit the bid after accepting both terms.
Verify that the vendor portal accepted the bid.
Return to the buyer's event page to verify the resulting acceptance status.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Assert the buyer sees that the bidding vendor accepted the mandatory terms.
